description: On the counter in front of the hands are a blue bowl, a small yellow toy duck, two dark cherries with a stem, a green block, a small wooden block, a white-lidded container, and a small yellow bread-shaped piece. The left hand stays resting on the counter while the right hand reaches in toward the yellow bread-shaped piece, grasps it as the right-hand object, lifts it up and to the right, then lowers it into the blue bowl and releases it, leaving the bread piece inside.
